```typescriptreact
										/>
										<Field.Text
											name="description"
											label={t('profile-description')}
											multiline
											rows={4}
										/>
									</Box>
								</CardContent>
							</Card>

							{/* Assign Users Card */}
							<Card id="section-assign-users">
								<CardHeader title={t('assign-users')} />
								<CardContent>
									<Field.Autocomplete
										name="emails"
										label={t('user-emails')}
										placeholder={t('enter-emails')}
										multiple
										freeSolo
										options={DUMMY_EMAIL_OPTIONS}
										slotProps={{
											chip: {
												variant: 'soft',
											},
										}}
										sx={(theme) => {
											const minHeight = theme.spacing(16.5);
											return {
												minHeight,
												'& fieldset': {
													minHeight,
												},
											};
										}}
									/>
									<Typography
										variant="caption"
										sx={{ mt: 1, color: 'text.secondary', display: 'block' }}
									>
										{t('unregistered-emails-will-receive-invitation')}
									</Typography>
								</CardContent>
							</Card>

							{/* Permissions Card */}
							<Box>
								<HelperText
									errorMessage={form.formState.errors.permissions?.message}
									helperText={
										!form.formState.errors.permissions
											? t('at-least-one-permission-required')
											: undefined
									}
									sx={{
										mb: 1,
										mx: 0,
										...(form.formState.errors.permissions
											? {}
											: { color: 'text.secondary' }),
									}}
								/>
								<Card
									id="section-permissions"
									sx={(theme) => {
										return {
											'--error': theme.vars.customShadows.cardErrorOutline,
											'--normal': theme.vars.customShadows.card,
											boxShadow: 'var(--shadow-card)',
										};
									}}
									style={{
										['--shadow-card' as string]: form.formState.errors
											.permissions
											? 'var(--error)'
											: 'var(--normal)',
									}}
								>
									<CardHeader
										title={
											<Box
												sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 1 }}
											>
												<Typography variant="h6">{t('permissions')}</Typography>
												<Tooltip
													title={t('at-least-one-permission-required')}
													placement="top"
												>
													<IconButton
														size="small"
														sx={{ p: 0.5, color: 'text.secondary' }}
													>
														<Iconify icon="solar:info-circle-bold" width={20} />
													</IconButton>
												</Tooltip>
											</Box>
										}
									/>
									<CardContent>
										<QueryDisplay
											query={permissionsQuery}
											LoadingSlot={PermissionsSkeleton}
										>
											{({ data }) => {
												const transformedData = transformPermissionsData(
													data?.additionalData as unknown as Record<
														string,
														Record<
															string,
															{ key: string; name: string; description: string }
														>
													>,
												);

												return (
													<>
														{_.map(transformedData, (group) => (
															<Box
																key={group.moduleKey}
																id={`section-permission-${group.moduleKey}`}
																sx={{ scrollMarginTop: '100px' }}
															>
																<List
																	subheader={
																		<ListSubheader sx={{ px: 0 }}>
																			{group.module}
																		</ListSubheader>
																	}
																>
																{_.map(group.permissions, (permission) => {
																	const isChecked =
																		permissions?.includes(permission.key) ??
																		false;
																	return (
																		<PermissionListItem
																			key={permission.key}
																			permission={permission}
																			checked={isChecked}
																			onToggle={() => {
																				handlePermissionToggle(permission.key);
																			}}
																		/>
																	);
																})}
															</List>
															</Box>
														))}
													</>
												);
											}}
										</QueryDisplay>
									</CardContent>
								</Card>
							</Box>
						</Stack>

						<FloatingCard
							placement="bottom-center"
							offset={20}
							sx={{
								borderRadius: 2,
								display: 'flex',
								gap: 2,
								maxWidth: 700,
								padding: 1,
								width: 'fit-content',
								zIndex: 1000,
							}}
							parentContainerRef={
								floatingCardContainerRef as RefObject<HTMLElement | null>
							}
						>
							<Button
								type="submit"
								variant="contained"
								disabled={isPending}
								loading={isPending}
							>
								{_.capitalize(t('create-profile'))}
							</Button>
						</FloatingCard>
					</Form>
				</Stack>
			</Grid>
		</Grid>
	);
};

const PermissionListItem = ({
	permission,
	checked,
	onToggle,
}: {
	permission: Permission;
	checked: boolean;
	onToggle: () => void;
}) => {
	return (
		<ListItem
			sx={{ py: 0, px: 0 }}
			secondaryAction={
				<Switch
					edge="end"
					checked={checked}
					onChange={onToggle}
					color="success"
					slotProps={{
						input: {
							id: `${permission.key}-switch`,
							'aria-label': `${permission.key} switch`,
						},
					}}
				/>
			}
		>
			<ListItemButton sx={{ px: 0, pl: 1 }} onClick={onToggle}>
				<ListItemAvatar>
					<Avatar>
						<Iconify icon="solar:key-bold" width={24} />
					</Avatar>
				</ListItemAvatar>
				<ListItemText
					primary={permission.name}
					secondary={permission.description}
				/>
			</ListItemButton>
		</ListItem>
	);
};

export default NewStaffProfileForm;

// Skeleton loader for permissions list
const PermissionsSkeleton = () => {
	const modules = [
		{ id: 'module-1', itemCount: 4 },
		{ id: 'module-2', itemCount: 5 },
		{ id: 'module-3', itemCount: 3 },
	];
	const primaryWidths = [180, 200, 160, 220, 170]; // Fixed widths for variety
	const secondaryWidths = [250, 280, 240, 300, 260]; // Fixed widths for variety

	return (
		<>
			{modules.map((module) => (
				<List key={module.id}>
					<ListSubheader sx={{ px: 0 }}>
						<Skeleton variant="text" width={120} height={24} sx={{ mb: 1 }} />
					</ListSubheader>
					{Array.from({ length: module.itemCount }).map((_, itemIndex) => {
						const primaryWidth =
							primaryWidths[itemIndex % primaryWidths.length];
						const secondaryWidth =
							secondaryWidths[itemIndex % secondaryWidths.length];

						return (
							<ListItem
								key={`${module.id}-item-${itemIndex}`}
								sx={{ py: 0, px: 0 }}
								secondaryAction={
									<Skeleton
										variant="rectangular"
										width={44}
										height={24}
										sx={{ borderRadius: 12 }}
									/>
								}
							>
								<ListItemButton sx={{ px: 0, pl: 1 }} disabled>
									<ListItemAvatar>
										<Skeleton variant="circular" width={40} height={40} />
									</ListItemAvatar>
									<ListItemText
										primary={
											<Skeleton
												variant="text"
												width={primaryWidth}
												height={20}
											/>
										}
										secondary={
											<Skeleton
												variant="text"
												width={secondaryWidth}
												height={16}
												sx={{ mt: 0.5 }}
											/>
										}
									/>
								</ListItemButton>
							</ListItem>
						);
					})}
				</List>
			))}
		</>
	);
};
```

```typescriptreact
import _ from 'lodash';
import List from '@mui/material/List';
import ListItem from '@mui/material/ListItem';
import ListItemButton from '@mui/material/ListItemButton';
import ListItemText from '@mui/material/ListItemText';
import Paper from '@mui/material/Paper';
import Typography from '@mui/material/Typography';
import { useScrollspy } from '@/front/hooks/use-scrollspy';
import { useTranslate } from '@/front/hooks/use-translate';
import { useFindStaffPermissions } from '@/front/lib/react-query/features/staff/staff-profile.hooks';
import QueryDisplay from '@/front/components/query-display';
import Skeleton from '@mui/material/Skeleton';
import Box from '@mui/material/Box';
import { useMemo } from 'react';

// Transform API response to component format (same as in form)
const transformPermissionsData = (
	apiData: Record<
		string,
		Record<string, { key: string; name: string; description: string }>
	>,
): Array<{ module: string; moduleKey: string }> => {
	return _.map(apiData, (_permissions, moduleName) => ({
		module: _.startCase(moduleName),
		moduleKey: moduleName,
	}));
};

const NewStaffProfileSidebar = () => {
	const { t, currentLang } = useTranslate();
	const permissionsQuery = useFindStaffPermissions({
		variables: {
			language: currentLang.value,
		},
	});

	// Build section IDs dynamically based on permissions
	const sectionIds = useMemo(() => {
		const baseSections = [
			'section-profile-details',
			'section-assign-users',
			'section-permissions',
		];

		if (permissionsQuery.data?.additionalData) {
			const transformedData = transformPermissionsData(
				permissionsQuery.data.additionalData as unknown as Record<
					string,
					Record<string, { key: string; name: string; description: string }>
				>,
			);

			const permissionSectionIds = transformedData.map(
				(item) => `section-permission-${item.moduleKey}`,
			);

			return [...baseSections, ...permissionSectionIds];
		}

		return baseSections;
	}, [permissionsQuery.data]);

	const activeSection = useScrollspy({
		sectionIds,
		offset: 100,
	});

	const handleClick = (sectionId: string) => {
		const element = document.getElementById(sectionId);
		if (element) {
			const offset = 100; // Same as scrollspy offset
			const elementPosition = element.getBoundingClientRect().top;
			const offsetPosition = elementPosition + window.scrollY - offset;

			window.scrollTo({
				top: offsetPosition,
				behavior: 'smooth',
			});
		}
	};

	// Build sections list with permission categories
	const sections = useMemo(() => {
		const baseSections = [
			{
				id: 'section-profile-details',
				title: t('profile-details'),
			},
			{
				id: 'section-assign-users',
				title: t('assign-users'),
			},
			{
				id: 'section-permissions',
				title: t('permissions'),
			},
		];

		if (permissionsQuery.data?.additionalData) {
			const transformedData = transformPermissionsData(
				permissionsQuery.data.additionalData as unknown as Record<
					string,
					Record<string, { key: string; name: string; description: string }>
				>,
			);

			const permissionSections = transformedData.map((item) => ({
				id: `section-permission-${item.moduleKey}`,
				title: item.module,
			}));

			return [...baseSections, ...permissionSections];
		}

		return baseSections;
	}, [permissionsQuery.data, t]);

	return (
		<Paper
			variant="outlined"
			sx={{
				p: 2,
				width: 1,
				maxWidth: 320,
				borderRadius: 1.5,
				display: 'flex',
				flexDirection: 'column',
			}}
		>
			<Typography variant="h6" sx={{ mb: 2, fontWeight: 600 }}>
				{t('overview')}
			</Typography>
			<QueryDisplay
				query={permissionsQuery}
				LoadingSlot={() => (
					<Box>
						{Array.from({ length: 5 }).map((_, i) => (
							<Skeleton
								key={i}
								variant="rectangular"
								height={40}
								sx={{ mb: 0.5, borderRadius: 1 }}
							/>
						))}
					</Box>
				)}
			>
				{() => (
					<List sx={{ p: 0 }}>
						{sections.map((section) => {
							const isActive = activeSection === section.id;
							const isPermissionCategory = section.id.startsWith(
								'section-permission-',
							);
							return (
								<ListItem key={section.id} disablePadding>
									<ListItemButton
										onClick={() => handleClick(section.id)}
										selected={isActive}
										sx={{
											borderRadius: 1,
											mb: 0.5,
											pl: isPermissionCategory ? 2 : 1,
											...(isActive && {
												bgcolor: 'action.selected',
												'&:hover': {
													bgcolor: 'action.selected',
												},
											}),
										}}
									>
										<ListItemText
											primary={section.title}
											primaryTypographyProps={{
												variant: 'body2',
												fontWeight: isActive ? 600 : 400,
												fontSize: isPermissionCategory ? '0.875rem' : undefined,
											}}
										/>
									</ListItemButton>
								</ListItem>
							);
						})}
					</List>
				)}
			</QueryDisplay>
		</Paper>
	);
};

export default NewStaffProfileSidebar;
```

```typescriptreact
											pl: isPermissionCategory ? 2 : 1,
											...(isActive && {
												bgcolor: 'action.selected',
												'&:hover': {
													bgcolor: 'action.selected',
												},
											}),
										}}
									>
										<ListItemText
											primary={section.title}
											primaryTypographyProps={{
												variant: 'body2',
												fontWeight: isActive ? 600 : 400,
												fontSize: isPermissionCategory ? '0.875rem' : undefined,
											}}
										/>
									</ListItemButton>
								</ListItem>
							);
						})}
					</List>
				)}
			</QueryDisplay>
		</Paper>
	);
};

export default NewStaffProfileSidebar;
```

```typescriptreact
import { useSyncFormToLang } from '@/front/hooks/use-sync-form-to-lang';
import { useTranslate } from '@/front/hooks/use-translate';

import {

import { logger } from '@/shared/lib/logger/iso-logger';
import { getNewStaffProfileSchema } from '@/shared/validations/staff-profile.validations';
import NewStaffProfileSidebar from './new-staff-profile-sidebar';

// Types for permissions data
type PermissionSlice = {
	module: string;
	moduleKey: string;
	permissions: Permission[];
};

type Permission = {
	key: string;
	name: string;
	description: string;
};

const DUMMY_EMAIL_OPTIONS = [
	'john.doe@example.com',
	'jane.smith@example.com',
	'admin@example.com',
	'support@example.com',
	'manager@example.com',
	'developer@example.com',
	'designer@example.com',
	'analyst@example.com',
];

type NewStaffProfileSchemaType = zod.infer<
	ReturnType<typeof getNewStaffProfileSchema>
>;

const defaultValues: NewStaffProfileSchemaType = {
	name: '',
	description: '',
	permissions: [],
	emails: [],
};

// Transform API response to component format
const transformPermissionsData = (
	apiData: Record<
		string,
		Record<string, { key: string; name: string; description: string }>
	>,
): Array<PermissionSlice & { moduleKey: string }> => {
	return _.map(apiData, (permissions, moduleName) => ({
		module: _.startCase(moduleName),
		moduleKey: moduleName,
		permissions: _.map(permissions, (permission) => ({
			key: permission.key,
			name: permission.name,
			description: permission.description,
		})),
	}));
};

const NewStaffProfileForm = () => {
	const { t, i18n, currentLang } = useTranslate();
	const isMobile = useIsMobile();
	const [sidebarSticky, setSidebarSticky] = useState(false);
	const [sidebarStyle, setSidebarStyle] = useState<{
		width: number;
		left: number;
	} | null>(null);
	const sidebarRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
	const parentRef = useRef<HTMLElement | Document>(document);
	const scrollPosition = useScrollPosition({ targetRef: parentRef });
	const permissionsQuery = useFindStaffPermissions({
		variables: {
			language: currentLang.value,
		},
	});

	const router = useRouter();
	const queryClient = useQueryClient();
	const floatingCardContainerRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

	// Effect to update parentRef after the component mounts
	useEffect(() => {
		const scrollableElement = document.getElementById('scrollable_content');
		if (scrollableElement) {
			parentRef.current = scrollableElement;
		} else {
			// Fallback to window/document scrolling
			parentRef.current = document;
		}
	}, []);

	// Handle scroll position and sidebar stickiness
	useEffect(() => {
		const shouldBeSticky = scrollPosition > 100;

		if (shouldBeSticky && sidebarRef.current) {
			// Calculate position immediately for instant sticky positioning
			const rect = sidebarRef.current.getBoundingClientRect();
			const newStyle = {
				width: rect.width,
				left: rect.left,
			};

			// Update both states synchronously to avoid double renders
			setSidebarSticky(true);
			setSidebarStyle((prev) => {
				// Only update if values changed significantly (avoid micro-adjustments)
				if (
					prev &&
					Math.abs(prev.width - newStyle.width) < 1 &&
					Math.abs(prev.left - newStyle.left) < 1
				) {
					return prev;
				}
				return newStyle;
			});
		} else if (!shouldBeSticky) {
			// Reset when not sticky
			setSidebarSticky(false);
			setSidebarStyle(null);
		}
	}, [scrollPosition]);

	const NewStaffProfileSchema = getNewStaffProfileSchema(defaultZodClient);

	const form = useForm<NewStaffProfileSchemaType>({
		mode: 'onSubmit',
		resolver: zodResolver(NewStaffProfileSchema),
		defaultValues,
	});

	useSyncFormToLang(i18n.language, form);

	const permissions = form.watch('permissions') as string[];

	const { mutate: createProfile, isPending } = useCreateStaffProfile({
		onSuccess: () => {
			toast.success(t('profile-created-successfully'));
			queryClient.invalidateQueries({
				queryKey: useFindStaffProfiles.getKey(),
			});
			form.reset();
			router.push(FRONT_PATH_NAMES.staff.profiles.root);
		},
		onError: (error) => {
			if (isJsClientError(error)) {
				toast.error(
					error.key
						? t(error.key as never, { ns: I18N_NAMESPACES.RESPONSE_MESSAGE })
						: error.messageEscaped,
				);
				return;
			}
			toast.error(_.trim(error.message) || t('unknown-error'));
		},
	});

	const onSubmit = form.handleSubmit(
		(data) => {
			logger.debug('🚀🚀🚀 Submitting new staff profile form', {
				data,
			});
			createProfile({
				name: data.name,
				description: data.description || undefined,
				permissions: data.permissions,
				emails: data.emails,
			});
		},
		(err) => {
			logger.debug('❌❌❌ Error on submitting new staff profile form', {
				error: err,
			});
		},
	);

	const handlePermissionToggle = useCallback(
		(permissionKey: string) => {
			const currentPermissions = permissions || [];
			const isSelected = currentPermissions.includes(permissionKey);

			if (isSelected) {
				form.setValue(
					'permissions',
					currentPermissions.filter((p) => p !== permissionKey),
					{
						shouldValidate: true,
					},
				);
			} else {
				form.setValue('permissions', [...currentPermissions, permissionKey], {
					shouldValidate: true,
				});
			}
		},
		[permissions, form],
	);

	return (
		<Grid container spacing={3}>
			{!isMobile && (
				<Grid size={{ md: 3 }} display={{ xs: 'none', md: 'block' }}>
					<Box
						ref={sidebarRef}
						sx={(theme) => ({
							// Use will-change for better performance
							willChange: sidebarSticky ? 'position, width, left' : 'auto',
							...(sidebarSticky &&
								sidebarStyle && {
									position: 'fixed',
									zIndex: theme.zIndex.appBar - 1,
									top: 'calc(var(--layout-header-desktop-height, 72px) + 1rem)',
									width: `${sidebarStyle.width}px`,
									left: `${sidebarStyle.left}px`,
									// Smooth transition only when becoming unsticky
									transition: 'none', // Disable transition for instant positioning
								}),
						})}
					>
						<NewStaffProfileSidebar />
					</Box>
				</Grid>
			)}
			<Grid size={{ xs: 12, md: 9 }}>
				<Stack ref={floatingCardContainerRef}>
					<Form methods={form} onSubmit={onSubmit}>
						<Stack spacing={3}>
							{/* Basic Info Card */}
							<Card id="section-profile-details">
								<CardHeader title={t('profile-details')} />
								<CardContent>
									<Box sx={{ rowGap: 3, columnGap: 2, display: 'grid' }}>
										<Field.Text
											name="name"
											label={t('profile-name')}
											required
										/>
										<Field.Text
											name="description"
											label={t('profile-description')}
											multiline
											rows={4}
										/>
									</Box>
								</CardContent>
							</Card>

							{/* Assign Users Card */}
							<Card id="section-assign-users">
								<CardHeader title={t('assign-users')} />
								<CardContent>
									<Field.Autocomplete
										name="emails"
										label={t('user-emails')}
										placeholder={t('enter-emails')}
										multiple
										freeSolo
										options={DUMMY_EMAIL_OPTIONS}
										slotProps={{
											chip: {
												variant: 'soft',
											},
										}}
										sx={(theme) => {
											const minHeight = theme.spacing(16.5);
											return {
												minHeight,
												'& fieldset': {
													minHeight,
												},
											};
										}}
									/>
									<Typography
										variant="caption"
										sx={{ mt: 1, color: 'text.secondary', display: 'block' }}
									>
										{t('unregistered-emails-will-receive-invitation')}
									</Typography>
								</CardContent>
							</Card>

							{/* Permissions Card */}
							<Box>
								<HelperText
									errorMessage={form.formState.errors.permissions?.message}
									helperText={
										!form.formState.errors.permissions
											? t('at-least-one-permission-required')
											: undefined
									}
									sx={{
										mb: 1,
										mx: 0,
										...(form.formState.errors.permissions
											? {}
											: { color: 'text.secondary' }),
									}}
								/>
								<Card
									id="section-permissions"
									sx={(theme) => {
										return {
											'--error': theme.vars.customShadows.cardErrorOutline,
											'--normal': theme.vars.customShadows.card,
											boxShadow: 'var(--shadow-card)',
										};
									}}
									style={{
										['--shadow-card' as string]: form.formState.errors
											.permissions
											? 'var(--error)'
											: 'var(--normal)',
									}}
								>
									<CardHeader
										title={
											<Box
												sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 1 }}
											>
												<Typography variant="h6">{t('permissions')}</Typography>
												<Tooltip
													title={t('at-least-one-permission-required')}
													placement="top"
												>
													<IconButton
														size="small"
														sx={{ p: 0.5, color: 'text.secondary' }}
													>
														<Iconify icon="solar:info-circle-bold" width={20} />
													</IconButton>
												</Tooltip>
											</Box>
										}
									/>
									<CardContent>
										<QueryDisplay
											query={permissionsQuery}
											LoadingSlot={PermissionsSkeleton}
										>
											{({ data }) => {
												const transformedData = transformPermissionsData(
													data?.additionalData as unknown as Record<
														string,
														Record<
															string,
															{ key: string; name: string; description: string }
														>
													>,
												);

												return (
													<>
														{_.map(transformedData, (group) => (
															<Box
																key={group.moduleKey}
																id={`section-permission-${group.moduleKey}`}
																sx={{ scrollMarginTop: '100px' }}
															>
																<List
																	subheader={
																		<ListSubheader sx={{ px: 0 }}>
																			{group.module}
																		</ListSubheader>
																	}
																>
																{_.map(group.permissions, (permission) => {
																	const isChecked =
																		permissions?.includes(permission.key) ??
																		false;
																	return (
																		<PermissionListItem
																			key={permission.key}
																			permission={permission}
																			checked={isChecked}
																			onToggle={() => {
																				handlePermissionToggle(permission.key);
																			}}
																		/>
																	);
																})}
															</List>
															</Box>
														))}
													</>
												);
											}}
										</QueryDisplay>
									</CardContent>
								</Card>
							</Box>
						</Stack>

						<FloatingCard
							placement="bottom-center"
							offset={20}
							sx={{
								borderRadius: 2,
								display: 'flex',
								gap: 2,
								maxWidth: 700,
								padding: 1,
								width: 'fit-content',
								zIndex: 1000,
							}}
							parentContainerRef={
								floatingCardContainerRef as RefObject<HTMLElement | null>
							}
						>
							<Button
								type="submit"
								variant="contained"
								disabled={isPending}
								loading={isPending}
							>
								{_.capitalize(t('create-profile'))}
							</Button>
						</FloatingCard>
					</Form>
				</Stack>
			</Grid>
		</Grid>
	);
};

const PermissionListItem = ({
	permission,
	checked,
	onToggle,
}: {
	permission: Permission;
	checked: boolean;
	onToggle: () => void;
}) => {
	return (
		<ListItem
			sx={{ py: 0, px: 0 }}
			secondaryAction={
				<Switch
					edge="end"
					checked={checked}
					onChange={onToggle}
					color="success"
					slotProps={{
						input: {
							id: `${permission.key}-switch`,
							'aria-label': `${permission.key} switch`,
						},
					}}
				/>
			}
		>
			<ListItemButton sx={{ px: 0, pl: 1 }} onClick={onToggle}>
				<ListItemAvatar>
					<Avatar>
						<Iconify icon="solar:key-bold" width={24} />
					</Avatar>
				</ListItemAvatar>
				<ListItemText
					primary={permission.name}
					secondary={permission.description}
				/>
			</ListItemButton>
		</ListItem>
	);
};

export default NewStaffProfileForm;

// Skeleton loader for permissions list
const PermissionsSkeleton = () => {
	const modules = [
		{ id: 'module-1', itemCount: 4 },
		{ id: 'module-2', itemCount: 5 },
		{ id: 'module-3', itemCount: 3 },
	];
	const primaryWidths = [180, 200, 160, 220, 170]; // Fixed widths for variety
	const secondaryWidths = [250, 280, 240, 300, 260]; // Fixed widths for variety

	return (
		<>
			{modules.map((module) => (
				<List key={module.id}>
					<ListSubheader sx={{ px: 0 }}>
						<Skeleton variant="text" width={120} height={24} sx={{ mb: 1 }} />
					</ListSubheader>
					{Array.from({ length: module.itemCount }).map((_, itemIndex) => {
						const primaryWidth =
							primaryWidths[itemIndex % primaryWidths.length];
						const secondaryWidth =
							secondaryWidths[itemIndex % secondaryWidths.length];

						return (
							<ListItem
								key={`${module.id}-item-${itemIndex}`}
								sx={{ py: 0, px: 0 }}
								secondaryAction={
									<Skeleton
										variant="rectangular"
										width={44}
										height={24}
										sx={{ borderRadius: 12 }}
									/>
								}
							>
								<ListItemButton sx={{ px: 0, pl: 1 }} disabled>
									<ListItemAvatar>
										<Skeleton variant="circular" width={40} height={40} />
									</ListItemAvatar>
									<ListItemText
										primary={
											<Skeleton
												variant="text"
												width={primaryWidth}
												height={20}
											/>
										}
										secondary={
											<Skeleton
												variant="text"
												width={secondaryWidth}
												height={16}
												sx={{ mt: 0.5 }}
											/>
										}
									/>
								</ListItemButton>
							</ListItem>
						);
					})}
				</List>
			))}
		</>
	);
};
```

## Summary

1. **Updated the sidebar** (`new-staff-profile-sidebar.tsx`):
   - Fetches permissions data using `useFindStaffPermissions`
   - Dynamically builds section IDs for each permission category
   - Adds navigation items for each permission category/module
   - Indents permission categories slightly (pl: 2) to show hierarchy
   - Shows a loading skeleton while permissions are loading

2. **Updated the form** (`new-staff-profile-form.tsx`):
   - Added `moduleKey` to the `PermissionSlice` type
   - Updated `transformPermissionsData` to include `moduleKey`
   - Wrapped each permission category `List` in a `Box` with an ID (`section-permission-{moduleKey}`)
   - Added `scrollMarginTop: '100px'` to ensure proper scroll positioning

3. **Scrollspy integration**:
   - The sidebar dynamically includes all permission category sections in the scrollspy
   - Clicking a permission category scrolls to that section
   - The active section is highlighted as you scroll

The sidebar now shows:
- Profile Details
- Assign Users
- Permissions (main section)
- Each permission category (e.g., "Staff Members", "Tenants", etc.) as a nested item

Each permission category is clickable and scrolls to its section in the form.

```typescriptreact
import Box from '@mui/material/Box';
import List from '@mui/material/List';
import ListItem from '@mui/material/ListItem';
import ListItemButton from '@mui/material/ListItemButton';
import ListItemText from '@mui/material/ListItemText';
import ListSubheader from '@mui/material/ListSubheader';
import Paper from '@mui/material/Paper';
import Skeleton from '@mui/material/Skeleton';
import Typography from '@mui/material/Typography';
import _ from 'lodash';
import { useMemo } from 'react';
import QueryDisplay from '@/front/components/query-display';
import { useScrollspy } from '@/front/hooks/use-scrollspy';
import { useTranslate } from '@/front/hooks/use-translate';
import { useFindStaffPermissions } from '@/front/lib/react-query/features/staff/staff-profile.hooks';

// Transform API response to component format (same as in form)
const transformPermissionsData = (
	apiData: Record<
		string,
		Record<string, { key: string; name: string; description: string }>
	>,
): Array<{ module: string; moduleKey: string }> => {
	return _.map(apiData, (_permissions, moduleName) => ({
		module: _.startCase(moduleName),
		moduleKey: moduleName,
	}));
};

const NewStaffProfileSidebar = () => {
	const { t, currentLang } = useTranslate();
	const permissionsQuery = useFindStaffPermissions({
		variables: {
			language: currentLang.value,
		},
	});

	// Build section IDs dynamically based on permissions
	const sectionIds = useMemo(() => {
		const baseSections = [
			'section-profile-details',
			'section-assign-users',
			'section-permissions',
		];

		if (permissionsQuery.data?.additionalData) {
			const transformedData = transformPermissionsData(
				permissionsQuery.data.additionalData as unknown as Record<
					string,
					Record<string, { key: string; name: string; description: string }>
				>,
			);

			const permissionSectionIds = transformedData.map(
				(item) => `section-permission-${item.moduleKey}`,
			);

			return [...baseSections, ...permissionSectionIds];
		}

		return baseSections;
	}, [permissionsQuery.data]);

	const activeSection = useScrollspy({
		sectionIds,
		offset: 100,
	});

	const handleClick = (sectionId: string) => {
		const element = document.getElementById(sectionId);
		if (element) {
			const offset = 100; // Same as scrollspy offset
			const elementPosition = element.getBoundingClientRect().top;
			const offsetPosition = elementPosition + window.scrollY - offset;

			window.scrollTo({
				top: offsetPosition,
				behavior: 'smooth',
			});
		}
	};

	// Build sections list with permission categories
	const sections = useMemo(() => {
		const baseSections = [
			{
				id: 'section-profile-details',
				title: t('profile-details'),
			},
			{
				id: 'section-assign-users',
				title: t('assign-users'),
			},
			{
				id: 'section-permissions',
				title: t('permissions'),
			},
		];

		if (permissionsQuery.data?.additionalData) {
			const transformedData = transformPermissionsData(
				permissionsQuery.data.additionalData as unknown as Record<
					string,
					Record<string, { key: string; name: string; description: string }>
				>,
			);

			const permissionSections = transformedData.map((item) => ({
				id: `section-permission-${item.moduleKey}`,
				title: item.module,
			}));

			return [...baseSections, ...permissionSections];
		}

		return baseSections;
	}, [permissionsQuery.data, t]);

	return (
		<Paper
			variant="outlined"
			sx={{
				p: 2,
				width: 1,
				maxWidth: 320,
				borderRadius: 1.5,
				display: 'flex',
				flexDirection: 'column',
			}}
		>
			<Typography variant="h6" sx={{ mb: 2, fontWeight: 600 }}>
				{t('overview')}
			</Typography>
			<QueryDisplay
				query={permissionsQuery}
				LoadingSlot={() => (
					<Box>
						{[
							'skeleton-1',
							'skeleton-2',
							'skeleton-3',
							'skeleton-4',
							'skeleton-5',
						].map((id) => (
							<Skeleton
								key={id}
								variant="rectangular"
								height={40}
								sx={{ mb: 0.5, borderRadius: 1 }}
							/>
						))}
					</Box>
				)}
			>
				{() => (

											pl: isPermissionCategory ? 2 : 1,
											...(isActive && {
												bgcolor: 'action.selected',
												'&:hover': {
													bgcolor: 'action.selected',
												},
											}),
										}}
									>
										<ListItemText
											primary={section.title}
											primaryTypographyProps={{
												variant: 'body2',
												fontWeight: isActive ? 600 : 400,
												fontSize: isPermissionCategory ? '0.875rem' : undefined,
											}}
										/>
									</ListItemButton>
								</ListItem>
							);
						})}
```
```typescriptreact
						{permissionsQuery.data?.additionalData && (
							<>
								<ListSubheader sx={{ px: 0, pt: 2, pb: 1 }}>
									{t('permissions')}
								</ListSubheader>
								{sections
									.filter((section) => section.id.startsWith('section-permission-'))
									.map((section) => {
										const isActive = activeSection === section.id;
										return (
											<ListItem key={section.id} disablePadding>
												<ListItemButton
													onClick={() => handleClick(section.id)}
													selected={isActive}
													sx={{
														borderRadius: 1,
														mb: 0.5,
														pl: 2,
														...(isActive && {
															bgcolor: 'action.selected',
															'&:hover': {
																bgcolor: 'action.selected',
															},
														}),
													}}
												>
													<ListItemText
														primary={section.title}
														primaryTypographyProps={{
															variant: 'body2',
															fontWeight: isActive ? 600 : 400,
															fontSize: '0.875rem',
														}}
													/>
												</ListItemButton>
											</ListItem>
										);
									})}
							</>
						)}
					</List>
				)}
			</QueryDisplay>
		</Paper>
	);
};

export default NewStaffProfileSidebar;
```

```typescriptreact
import Box from '@mui/material/Box';
import List from '@mui/material/List';
import ListItem from '@mui/material/ListItem';
import ListItemButton from '@mui/material/ListItemButton';
import ListItemText from '@mui/material/ListItemText';
import ListSubheader from '@mui/material/ListSubheader';
import Paper from '@mui/material/Paper';
import Skeleton from '@mui/material/Skeleton';
import Typography from '@mui/material/Typography';
import _ from 'lodash';
import { useMemo } from 'react';
import QueryDisplay from '@/front/components/query-display';
import { useScrollspy } from '@/front/hooks/use-scrollspy';
import { useTranslate } from '@/front/hooks/use-translate';
import { useFindStaffPermissions } from '@/front/lib/react-query/features/staff/staff-profile.hooks';

// Transform API response to component format (same as in form)
const transformPermissionsData = (
	apiData: Record<
		string,
		Record<string, { key: string; name: string; description: string }>
	>,
): Array<{ module: string; moduleKey: string }> => {
	return _.map(apiData, (_permissions, moduleName) => ({
		module: _.startCase(moduleName),
		moduleKey: moduleName,
	}));
};

const NewStaffProfileSidebar = () => {
	const { t, currentLang } = useTranslate();
	const permissionsQuery = useFindStaffPermissions({
		variables: {
			language: currentLang.value,
		},
	});

	// Build section IDs dynamically based on permissions
	// Note: 'section-permissions' is excluded as it's a subheader, not a trackable section
	const sectionIds = useMemo(() => {
		const baseSections = [
			'section-profile-details',
			'section-assign-users',
		];

		if (permissionsQuery.data?.additionalData) {
			const transformedData = transformPermissionsData(
				permissionsQuery.data.additionalData as unknown as Record<
					string,
					Record<string, { key: string; name: string; description: string }>
				>,
			);

			const permissionSectionIds = transformedData.map(
				(item) => `section-permission-${item.moduleKey}`,
			);

			return [...baseSections, ...permissionSectionIds];
		}

		return baseSections;
	}, [permissionsQuery.data]);

	const activeSection = useScrollspy({
		sectionIds,
		offset: 100,
	});

	const handleClick = (sectionId: string) => {
		const element = document.getElementById(sectionId);
		if (element) {
			const offset = 100; // Same as scrollspy offset
			const elementPosition = element.getBoundingClientRect().top;
			const offsetPosition = elementPosition + window.scrollY - offset;

			window.scrollTo({
				top: offsetPosition,
				behavior: 'smooth',
			});
		}
	};

	// Build base sections (excluding permissions which is a subheader)
	const baseSections = useMemo(
		() => [
			{
				id: 'section-profile-details',
				title: t('profile-details'),
			},
			{
				id: 'section-assign-users',
				title: t('assign-users'),
			},
		],
		[t],
	);

	// Build permission category sections
	const permissionSections = useMemo(() => {
		if (permissionsQuery.data?.additionalData) {
			const transformedData = transformPermissionsData(
				permissionsQuery.data.additionalData as unknown as Record<
					string,
					Record<string, { key: string; name: string; description: string }>
				>,
			);

			return transformedData.map((item) => ({
				id: `section-permission-${item.moduleKey}`,
				title: item.module,
			}));
		}

		return [];
	}, [permissionsQuery.data]);

	return (
		<Paper
			variant="outlined"
			sx={{
				p: 2,
				width: 1,
				maxWidth: 320,
				borderRadius: 1.5,
				display: 'flex',
				flexDirection: 'column',
			}}
		>
			<Typography variant="h6" sx={{ mb: 2, fontWeight: 600 }}>
				{t('overview')}
			</Typography>
			<QueryDisplay
				query={permissionsQuery}
				LoadingSlot={() => (
					<Box>
						{[
							'skeleton-1',
							'skeleton-2',
							'skeleton-3',
							'skeleton-4',
							'skeleton-5',
						].map((id) => (
							<Skeleton
								key={id}
								variant="rectangular"
								height={40}
								sx={{ mb: 0.5, borderRadius: 1 }}
							/>
						))}
					</Box>
				)}
			>
				{() => (
					<List sx={{ p: 0 }}>
						{/* Base sections */}
						{baseSections.map((section) => {
							const isActive = activeSection === section.id;
							return (
								<ListItem key={section.id} disablePadding>
									<ListItemButton
										onClick={() => handleClick(section.id)}
										selected={isActive}
										sx={{
											borderRadius: 1,
											mb: 0.5,
											pl: 1,
											...(isActive && {
												bgcolor: 'action.selected',
												'&:hover': {
													bgcolor: 'action.selected',
												},
											}),
										}}
									>
										<ListItemText
											primary={section.title}
											primaryTypographyProps={{
												variant: 'body2',
												fontWeight: isActive ? 600 : 400,
											}}
										/>
									</ListItemButton>
								</ListItem>
							);
						})}
						{/* Permissions subheader and categories */}
						{permissionSections.length > 0 && (
							<>
								<ListSubheader sx={{ px: 0, pt: 2, pb: 1 }}>
									{t('permissions')}
								</ListSubheader>
								{permissionSections.map((section) => {
									const isActive = activeSection === section.id;
									return (
										<ListItem key={section.id} disablePadding>
											<ListItemButton
												onClick={() => handleClick(section.id)}
												selected={isActive}
												sx={{
													borderRadius: 1,
													mb: 0.5,
													pl: 2,
													...(isActive && {
														bgcolor: 'action.selected',
														'&:hover': {
															bgcolor: 'action.selected',
														},
													}),
												}}
											>
												<ListItemText
													primary={section.title}
													primaryTypographyProps={{
														variant: 'body2',
														fontWeight: isActive ? 600 : 400,
														fontSize: '0.875rem',
													}}
												/>
											</ListItemButton>
										</ListItem>
									);
								})}
							</>
						)}
					</List>
				)}
			</QueryDisplay>
		</Paper>
	);
};

export default NewStaffProfileSidebar;

```


Updated the sidebar:

1. Removed "section-permissions" from scrollspy tracking — it's no longer in the `sectionIds` array.
2. Made "Permissions" a subheader — using `ListSubheader` instead of a clickable item.
3. Separated rendering logic — base sections render first, then the "Permissions" subheader, then permission categories as nested items.

The sidebar structure is now:
- **Profile Details** (clickable, tracked by scrollspy)
- **Assign Users** (clickable, tracked by scrollspy)
- **Permissions** (subheader, not tracked)
  - Permission Category 1 (clickable, tracked)
  - Permission Category 2 (clickable, tracked)
  - etc.

Permission categories are indented (`pl: 2`) and appear under the "Permissions" subheader. The "Permissions" subheader is not tracked by scrollspy and serves as a visual separator.

Creating a custom NavList wrapper to handle scrollspy-based active state and click handlers:


```typescriptreact
import _ from 'lodash';
import { useBoolean } from 'minimal-shared/hooks';
import { isExternalLink } from 'minimal-shared/utils';
import { useCallback, useEffect, useRef } from 'react';
import { NavCollapse, NavLi, NavUl } from '@/front/components/nav-section/components';
import { navSectionClasses } from '@/front/components/nav-section/styles';
import type { NavListProps, NavSubListProps } from '@/front/components/nav-section/types';
import { NavItem } from '@/front/components/nav-section/vertical/nav-item';

// ----------------------------------------------------------------------

type CustomNavListProps = NavListProps & {
	activeSection?: string | null;
	onSectionClick?: (sectionId: string) => void;
};

export const CustomNavList = ({
	data,
	depth,
	render,
	slotProps,
	checkPermissions,
	enabledRootRedirect,
	activeSection,
	onSectionClick,
}: CustomNavListProps) => {
	const navItemRef = useRef<HTMLButtonElement>(null);

	// Determine active state based on scrollspy instead of pathname
	const sectionId = data.path.replace('#', '');
	const isActive = activeSection === sectionId;

	const { value: open, onFalse: onClose, onToggle } = useBoolean(isActive);

	// biome-ignore lint/correctness/useExhaustiveDependencies: code from template leave as is for now
	useEffect(() => {
		if (!isActive) {
			onClose();
		}
	}, [isActive, onClose]);

	const handleClick = useCallback(() => {
		if (data.children) {
			onToggle();
		} else if (onSectionClick && data.path.startsWith('#')) {
			// Handle scroll to section
			onSectionClick(sectionId);
		}
	}, [data.children, data.path, onSectionClick, onToggle, sectionId]);

	const renderNavItem = () => {
		return (
			<NavItem
				ref={navItemRef}
				// slots
				path={data.path}
				icon={data.icon}
				info={data.info}
				title={data.title}
				caption={data.caption}
				// state
				open={open}
				active={isActive}
				disabled={data.disabled}
				// options
				depth={depth}
				render={render}
				hasChild={!!data.children}
				externalLink={isExternalLink(data.path)}
				enabledRootRedirect={enabledRootRedirect}
				// styles
				slotProps={depth === 1 ? slotProps?.rootItem : slotProps?.subItem}
				// actions
				onClick={handleClick}
			/>
		);
	};

	const renderCollapse = () => {
		return (
			!!data.children && (
				<NavCollapse
					mountOnEnter
					unmountOnExit
					depth={depth}
					in={open}
					data-group={data.title}
				>
					<CustomNavSubList
						data={data.children}
						render={render}
						depth={depth}
						slotProps={slotProps}
						checkPermissions={checkPermissions}
						enabledRootRedirect={enabledRootRedirect}
						activeSection={activeSection}
						onSectionClick={onSectionClick}
					/>
				</NavCollapse>
			)
		);
	};

	// Hidden item by role
	if (
		data.allowedRoles &&
		checkPermissions &&
		checkPermissions(data.allowedRoles)
	) {
		return null;
	}

	return (
		<NavLi
			disabled={data.disabled}
			sx={{
				...(!!data.children && {
					[`& .${navSectionClasses.li}`]: {
						'&:first-of-type': { mt: 'var(--nav-item-gap)' },
					},
				}),
			}}
		>
			{renderNavItem()}
			{renderCollapse()}
		</NavLi>
	);
};

// ----------------------------------------------------------------------

type CustomNavSubListProps = NavSubListProps & {
	activeSection?: string | null;
	onSectionClick?: (sectionId: string) => void;
};

const CustomNavSubList = ({
	data,
	render,
	depth = 0,
	slotProps,
	checkPermissions,
	enabledRootRedirect,
	activeSection,
	onSectionClick,
}: CustomNavSubListProps) => {
	return (
		<NavUl sx={{ gap: 'var(--nav-item-gap)' }}>
			{data.map((list) => {
				return (
					<CustomNavList
						key={list.title}
						data={list}
						render={render}
						depth={depth + 1}
						slotProps={slotProps}
						checkPermissions={checkPermissions}
						enabledRootRedirect={enabledRootRedirect}
						activeSection={activeSection}
						onSectionClick={onSectionClick}
					/>
				);
			})}
		</NavUl>
	);
};
```

```typescriptreact
			const elementPosition = element.getBoundingClientRect().top;

			{

				path: '#section-assign-users',
				title: t('assign-users'),

		const permissionItems =
			permissionsQuery.data?.additionalData

						permissionsQuery.data.additionalData as unknown as Record<
							string,
							Record<string, { key: string; name: string; description: string }>
						>,
					).map((item) => ({
						path: `#section-permission-${item.moduleKey}`,
						title: item.module,
					}))
				: [];

		return [
			{
				items: baseItems,
			},
			...(permissionItems.length > 0
				? [
						{
							subheader: t('permissions'),
							items: permissionItems,
						},
					]
				: []),
		];
	}, [permissionsQuery.data, t]);

	// Helper to get section ID from path
	const getSectionIdFromPath = (path: string): string => {
		return path.replace('#', '');
	};

	// Helper to check if a path is active based on scrollspy
	const isPathActive = (path: string): boolean => {
		const sectionId = getSectionIdFromPath(path);
		return activeSection === sectionId;
	};

	const config = {
		gap: 4,
		icon: 24,
		radius: 8,
		subItemHeight: 36,
		rootItemHeight: 44,
		padding: '4px 8px 4px 12px',
	};
```

```typescriptreact
	const theme = useTheme();
	const cssVars = navSectionCssVars.vertical(theme);

	// Custom Group component that uses CustomNavList
	const Group = ({
		items,
		render,
		subheader,
		collapsible,
		slotProps,
		checkPermissions,
		enabledRootRedirect,
	}: NavGroupProps) => {
		const { value: open, onToggle } = useBoolean(true);

		const renderContent = () => {
			return (
				<NavUl sx={{ gap: 'var(--nav-item-gap)' }}>

			);

			if (!subheader) {
				return null;
			}

			if (isCollapsible) {
				return (

						component="div"

						sx={{

							py: 1,
							cursor: 'pointer',
							userSelect: 'none',
							fontSize: '0.75rem',

							textTransform: 'uppercase',
							color: 'text.secondary',
							...(slotProps?.subheader as Record<string, unknown>),
						}}
					>
						{subheader}
					</Box>
				);
			}

			return (
				<Box
					component="div"
					sx={{
						px: 2,
						py: 1,
						fontSize: '0.75rem',
						fontWeight: 600,
						textTransform: 'uppercase',
						color: 'text.secondary',
						...(slotProps?.subheader as Record<string, unknown>),
					}}
				>
					{subheader}
				</Box>
			);
		};

		return (
			<Box>
				{renderSubheader()}
				{renderContent()}
			</Box>
		);
	};

	return (
		<Paper
			variant="outlined"
			sx={{
				p: 2,
				width: 1,
				maxWidth: 320,
				borderRadius: 1.5,
				display: 'flex',
				flexDirection: 'column',
			}}
		>
			<Typography variant="h6" sx={{ mb: 2, fontWeight: 600 }}>

				LoadingSlot={() => (

						{[

						checkPermissions={() => false}
						slotProps={{

									minHeight: config.rootItemHeight,
								},
								title: {},
							},
							subItem: {
								sx: {
									padding: config.padding,
									borderRadius: `${config.radius}px`,
									minHeight: config.subItemHeight,
								},
								title: {
									fontSize: '0.875rem',
								},
							},
							subheader: {},
						}}
					/>
				)}
			</QueryDisplay>
		</Paper>
	);
};
```

```typescriptreact
import Skeleton from '@mui/material/Skeleton';
import Typography from '@mui/material/Typography';
import { useTheme } from '@mui/material/styles';
```
```typescriptreact
import { useBoolean } from 'minimal-shared/hooks';
import _ from 'lodash';
import { useMemo } from 'react';
import QueryDisplay from '@/front/components/query-display';
import { Nav, NavLi, NavSubheader, NavUl } from '@/front/components/nav-section/components';
import { navSectionClasses, navSectionCssVars } from '@/front/components/nav-section/styles';
import type { NavGroupProps, NavSectionProps } from '@/front/components/nav-section/types';
import { useScrollspy } from '@/front/hooks/use-scrollspy';
import { useTranslate } from '@/front/hooks/use-translate';
import { useFindStaffPermissions } from '@/front/lib/react-query/features/staff/staff-profile.hooks';
import { CustomNavList } from './new-staff-profile-nav-list';

// Transform API response to component format (same as in form)
const transformPermissionsData = (
	apiData: Record<
		string,
		Record<string, { key: string; name: string; description: string }>
	>,
): Array<{ module: string; moduleKey: string }> => {
	return _.map(apiData, (_permissions, moduleName) => ({
		module: _.startCase(moduleName),
		moduleKey: moduleName,
	}));
};

const NewStaffProfileSidebar = () => {
	const { t, currentLang } = useTranslate();
	const permissionsQuery = useFindStaffPermissions({
		variables: {
			language: currentLang.value,
		},
	});

	// Build section IDs dynamically based on permissions
	// Note: 'section-permissions' is excluded as it's a subheader, not a trackable section
	const sectionIds = useMemo(() => {
		const baseSections = ['section-profile-details', 'section-assign-users'];

		if (permissionsQuery.data?.additionalData) {
			const transformedData = transformPermissionsData(
				permissionsQuery.data.additionalData as unknown as Record<
					string,
					Record<string, { key: string; name: string; description: string }>
				>,
			);

			const permissionSectionIds = transformedData.map(
				(item) => `section-permission-${item.moduleKey}`,
			);

			return [...baseSections, ...permissionSectionIds];
		}

		return baseSections;
	}, [permissionsQuery.data]);

	const activeSection = useScrollspy({
		sectionIds,
		offset: 100,
	});

	const handleClick = (sectionId: string) => {
		const element = document.getElementById(sectionId);
		if (element) {
			const offset = 100; // Same as scrollspy offset
			const elementPosition = element.getBoundingClientRect().top;
			const offsetPosition = elementPosition + window.scrollY - offset;

			window.scrollTo({
				top: offsetPosition,
				behavior: 'smooth',
			});
		}
	};

	// Build navigation data structure for NavSectionVertical
	const navData: NavSectionProps['data'] = useMemo(() => {
		const baseItems = [
			{
				path: '#section-profile-details',
				title: t('profile-details'),
			},
			{
				path: '#section-assign-users',
				title: t('assign-users'),
			},
		];

		const permissionItems =
			permissionsQuery.data?.additionalData
				? transformPermissionsData(
						permissionsQuery.data.additionalData as unknown as Record<
							string,
							Record<string, { key: string; name: string; description: string }>
						>,
					).map((item) => ({
						path: `#section-permission-${item.moduleKey}`,
						title: item.module,
					}))
				: [];

		return [
			{
				items: baseItems,
			},
			...(permissionItems.length > 0
				? [
						{
							subheader: t('permissions'),
							items: permissionItems,
						},
					]
				: []),
		];
	}, [permissionsQuery.data, t]);


	const config = {
		gap: 4,
		icon: 24,
		radius: 8,
		subItemHeight: 36,
		rootItemHeight: 44,
		padding: '4px 8px 4px 12px',
	};

	const theme = useTheme();
	const cssVars = navSectionCssVars.vertical(theme);

	// Custom Group component that uses CustomNavList
	const Group = ({
		items,
		render,
		subheader,
		collapsible,
		slotProps,
		checkPermissions,
		enabledRootRedirect,
	}: NavGroupProps) => {
		const { value: open, onToggle } = useBoolean(true);
		const isCollapsible = collapsible !== false;

		const renderContent = () => {
			return (
				<NavUl sx={{ gap: 'var(--nav-item-gap)' }}>
					{items.map((list) => {
						return (
							<CustomNavList
								key={list.title}
								data={list}
								render={render}
								depth={1}
								slotProps={slotProps}
								checkPermissions={checkPermissions}
								enabledRootRedirect={enabledRootRedirect}
								activeSection={activeSection}
								onSectionClick={handleClick}
							/>
						);
					})}
				</NavUl>
			);
		};

		const renderSubheader = () => {
			if (!subheader) {
				return null;
			}

			if (isCollapsible) {
				return (
					<Box
						component="div"
						data-title={subheader}
						onClick={onToggle}
						sx={{
							px: 2,
							py: 1,
							cursor: 'pointer',
							userSelect: 'none',
							fontSize: '0.75rem',
							fontWeight: 600,
							textTransform: 'uppercase',
							color: 'text.secondary',
							...(slotProps?.subheader as Record<string, unknown>),
						}}
					>
						{subheader}
					</Box>
				);
			}

			return (
				<Box
					component="div"
					sx={{
						px: 2,
						py: 1,
						fontSize: '0.75rem',
						fontWeight: 600,
						textTransform: 'uppercase',
						color: 'text.secondary',
						...(slotProps?.subheader as Record<string, unknown>),
					}}
				>
					{subheader}
				</Box>
			);
		};

		return (
			<Box>
				{renderSubheader()}
				{renderContent()}
			</Box>
		);
	};

	return (
		<Paper
			variant="outlined"
			sx={{
				p: 2,
				width: 1,
				maxWidth: 320,
				borderRadius: 1.5,
				display: 'flex',
				flexDirection: 'column',
			}}
		>
			<Typography variant="h6" sx={{ mb: 2, fontWeight: 600 }}>
				{t('overview')}
			</Typography>
			<QueryDisplay
				query={permissionsQuery}
				LoadingSlot={() => (
					<Box>
						{[
							'skeleton-1',
							'skeleton-2',
							'skeleton-3',
							'skeleton-4',
							'skeleton-5',
						].map((id) => (
							<Skeleton
								key={id}
								variant="rectangular"
								height={40}
								sx={{ mb: 0.5, borderRadius: 1 }}
							/>
						))}
					</Box>
				)}
			>
				{() => (
					<Nav
						className={navSectionClasses.vertical}
						sx={[
							{ ...cssVars, '--nav-item-gap': `${config.gap}px` },
							{ flex: '1 1 auto' },
						]}
					>
						<NavUl sx={{ flex: '1 1 auto', gap: 'var(--nav-item-gap)' }}>
							{navData.map((group) => {
								return (
									<Group
										key={group.subheader ?? group.items[0].title}
										subheader={group.subheader}
										collapsible={group.collapsible}
										items={group.items}
										render={{}}
										slotProps={{
											rootItem: {
												sx: {
													padding: config.padding,
													borderRadius: `${config.radius}px`,
													minHeight: config.rootItemHeight,
												},
												title: {},
											},
											subItem: {
												sx: {
													padding: config.padding,
													borderRadius: `${config.radius}px`,
													minHeight: config.subItemHeight,
												},
												title: {
													fontSize: '0.875rem',
												},
											},
											subheader: {},
										}}
										checkPermissions={() => false}
										enabledRootRedirect={false}
									/>
								);
							})}
						</NavUl>
					</Nav>
				)}
			</QueryDisplay>
		</Paper>
	);
};

export default NewStaffProfileSidebar;

```



Refactored the sidebar to use `NavSectionVertical` components instead of basic MUI components. Summary:

1. **Created `CustomNavList` component** (`new-staff-profile-nav-list.tsx`):
   - Extends the standard `NavList` functionality
   - Uses scrollspy-based active state instead of pathname-based
   - Handles click events to scroll to sections instead of navigation
   - Supports nested permission categories

2. **Refactored the sidebar** (`new-staff-profile-sidebar.tsx`):
   - Uses `NavSectionVertical` structure with `Nav`, `NavUl`, `NavLi`, `NavSubheader`
   - Custom `Group` component that renders sections with subheaders
   - "Permissions" is a `NavSubheader` (not tracked by scrollspy)
   - Permission categories are nested items under the subheader
   - Uses the same configuration pattern as the reference sidebar

3. **Features maintained**:
   - Scrollspy tracking for all sections (except the "Permissions" subheader)
   - Smooth scrolling on click
   - Active state highlighting
   - Loading states with skeletons
   - Dynamic permission categories from API

The sidebar now follows the same pattern as `staff-profile-sidebar.tsx`, using `NavSectionVertical` components while maintaining scrollspy functionality for section navigation.

```typescriptreact
import { zodResolver } from '@hookform/resolvers/zod';

import ListItemAvatar from '@mui/material/ListItemAvatar';
import ListItemButton from '@mui/material/ListItemButton';
import ListItemText from '@mui/material/ListItemText';
import ListSubheader from '@mui/material/ListSubheader';
import Skeleton from '@mui/material/Skeleton';
import Stack from '@mui/material/Stack';
import Switch from '@mui/material/Switch';
import Tooltip from '@mui/material/Tooltip';
import Typography from '@mui/material/Typography';
import { useQueryClient } from '@tanstack/react-query';
import _ from 'lodash';
import {
	type RefObject,
	useCallback,
	useEffect,
	useRef,
	useState,
} from 'react';
import { useForm } from 'react-hook-form';
import type zod from 'zod';
import { FloatingCard } from '@/front/components/floating-card';
import { Form } from '@/front/components/hook-form';
import { Field } from '@/front/components/hook-form/fields';
import { HelperText } from '@/front/components/hook-form/help-text';
import { Iconify } from '@/front/components/iconify/iconify';
import QueryDisplay from '@/front/components/query-display';
import { toast } from '@/front/components/snackbar';
import { useIsMobile } from '@/front/hooks/use-is-mobile';
import { useRouter } from '@/front/hooks/use-router';
import { useScrollPosition } from '@/front/hooks/use-scroll-position';
import { useSyncFormToLang } from '@/front/hooks/use-sync-form-to-lang';
import { useTranslate } from '@/front/hooks/use-translate';
import { isJsClientError } from '@/front/lib/js-client/js-client-error';
import {
	useCreateStaffProfile,
	useFindStaffPermissions,
	useFindStaffProfiles,
} from '@/front/lib/react-query/features/staff/staff-profile.hooks';
import { defaultZodClient } from '@/front/lib/zod/zod.client';
import { FRONT_PATH_NAMES, I18N_NAMESPACES } from '@/shared/lib/constants';
import { logger } from '@/shared/lib/logger/iso-logger';
import { getNewStaffProfileSchema } from '@/shared/validations/staff-profile.validations';
import NewStaffProfileSidebar from './new-staff-profile-sidebar';

// Types for permissions data
type PermissionSlice = {
	module: string;
	moduleKey: string;
	permissions: Permission[];
};

type Permission = {
	key: string;
	name: string;
	description: string;
};

const DUMMY_EMAIL_OPTIONS = [
	'john.doe@example.com',
	'jane.smith@example.com',
	'admin@example.com',
	'support@example.com',
	'manager@example.com',
	'developer@example.com',
	'designer@example.com',
	'analyst@example.com',
];

type NewStaffProfileSchemaType = zod.infer<
	ReturnType<typeof getNewStaffProfileSchema>
>;

const defaultValues: NewStaffProfileSchemaType = {
	name: '',
	description: '',
	permissions: [],
	emails: [],
};

// Transform API response to component format
const transformPermissionsData = (
	apiData: Record<
		string,
		Record<string, { key: string; name: string; description: string }>
	>,
): PermissionSlice[] => {
	return _.map(apiData, (permissions, moduleName) => ({
		module: _.startCase(moduleName),
		moduleKey: moduleName,
		permissions: _.map(permissions, (permission) => ({
			key: permission.key,
			name: permission.name,
			description: permission.description,
		})),
	}));
};

const NewStaffProfileForm = () => {
	const { t, i18n, currentLang } = useTranslate();
	const isMobile = useIsMobile();
	const [sidebarSticky, setSidebarSticky] = useState(false);
	const [sidebarStyle, setSidebarStyle] = useState<{
		width: number;
		left: number;
	} | null>(null);
	const sidebarRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
	const parentRef = useRef<HTMLElement | Document>(document);
	const scrollPosition = useScrollPosition({ targetRef: parentRef });
	const permissionsQuery = useFindStaffPermissions({
		variables: {
			language: currentLang.value,
		},
	});

	const router = useRouter();
	const queryClient = useQueryClient();
	const floatingCardContainerRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

	// Effect to update parentRef after the component mounts
	useEffect(() => {
		const scrollableElement = document.getElementById('scrollable_content');
		if (scrollableElement) {
			parentRef.current = scrollableElement;
		} else {
			// Fallback to window/document scrolling
			parentRef.current = document;
		}
	}, []);

	// Handle scroll position and sidebar stickiness
	useEffect(() => {
		const shouldBeSticky = scrollPosition > 100;

		if (shouldBeSticky && sidebarRef.current) {
			// Calculate position immediately for instant sticky positioning
			const rect = sidebarRef.current.getBoundingClientRect();
			const newStyle = {
				width: rect.width,
				left: rect.left,
			};

			// Update both states synchronously to avoid double renders
			setSidebarSticky(true);
			setSidebarStyle((prev) => {
				// Only update if values changed significantly (avoid micro-adjustments)
				if (
					prev &&
					Math.abs(prev.width - newStyle.width) < 1 &&
					Math.abs(prev.left - newStyle.left) < 1
				) {
					return prev;
				}
				return newStyle;
			});
		} else if (!shouldBeSticky) {
			// Reset when not sticky
			setSidebarSticky(false);
			setSidebarStyle(null);
		}
	}, [scrollPosition]);

	const NewStaffProfileSchema = getNewStaffProfileSchema(defaultZodClient);

	const form = useForm<NewStaffProfileSchemaType>({
		mode: 'onSubmit',
		resolver: zodResolver(NewStaffProfileSchema),
		defaultValues,
	});

	useSyncFormToLang(i18n.language, form);

	const permissions = form.watch('permissions') as string[];

	const { mutate: createProfile, isPending } = useCreateStaffProfile({
		onSuccess: () => {
			toast.success(t('profile-created-successfully'));
			queryClient.invalidateQueries({
				queryKey: useFindStaffProfiles.getKey(),
			});
			form.reset();
			router.push(FRONT_PATH_NAMES.staff.profiles.root);
		},
		onError: (error) => {
			if (isJsClientError(error)) {
				toast.error(
					error.key
						? t(error.key as never, { ns: I18N_NAMESPACES.RESPONSE_MESSAGE })
						: error.messageEscaped,
				);
				return;
			}
			toast.error(_.trim(error.message) || t('unknown-error'));
		},
	});

	const onSubmit = form.handleSubmit(
		(data) => {
			logger.debug('🚀🚀🚀 Submitting new staff profile form', {
				data,
			});
			createProfile({
				name: data.name,
				description: data.description || undefined,
				permissions: data.permissions,
				emails: data.emails,
			});
		},
		(err) => {
			logger.debug('❌❌❌ Error on submitting new staff profile form', {
				error: err,
			});
		},
	);

	const handlePermissionToggle = useCallback(
		(permissionKey: string) => {
			const currentPermissions = permissions || [];
			const isSelected = currentPermissions.includes(permissionKey);

			if (isSelected) {
				form.setValue(
					'permissions',
					currentPermissions.filter((p) => p !== permissionKey),
					{
						shouldValidate: true,
					},
				);
			} else {
				form.setValue('permissions', [...currentPermissions, permissionKey], {
					shouldValidate: true,
				});
			}
		},
		[permissions, form],
	);

	return (
		<Grid container spacing={3}>
			{!isMobile && (
				<Grid size={{ md: 3 }} display={{ xs: 'none', md: 'block' }}>
					<Box
						ref={sidebarRef}
						sx={(theme) => ({
							// Use will-change for better performance
							willChange: sidebarSticky ? 'position, width, left' : 'auto',
							...(sidebarSticky &&
								sidebarStyle && {
									position: 'fixed',
									zIndex: theme.zIndex.appBar - 1,
									top: 'calc(var(--layout-header-desktop-height, 72px) + 1rem)',
									width: `${sidebarStyle.width}px`,
									left: `${sidebarStyle.left}px`,
									// Smooth transition only when becoming unsticky
									transition: 'none', // Disable transition for instant positioning
								}),
						})}
					>
						<NewStaffProfileSidebar />
					</Box>
				</Grid>
			)}
			<Grid size={{ xs: 12, md: 9 }}>
				<Stack ref={floatingCardContainerRef}>
					<Form methods={form} onSubmit={onSubmit}>
						<Stack spacing={3}>
							{/* Basic Info Card */}
							<Card id="section-profile-details">
								<CardHeader title={t('profile-details')} />
								<CardContent>
									<Box sx={{ rowGap: 3, columnGap: 2, display: 'grid' }}>
										<Field.Text
											name="name"
											label={t('profile-name')}
											required
										/>
										<Field.Text
											name="description"
											label={t('profile-description')}
											multiline
											rows={4}
										/>
									</Box>
								</CardContent>
							</Card>

							{/* Assign Users Card */}
							<Card id="section-assign-users">
								<CardHeader title={t('assign-users')} />
								<CardContent>
									<Field.Autocomplete
										name="emails"
										label={t('user-emails')}
										placeholder={t('enter-emails')}
										multiple
										freeSolo
										options={DUMMY_EMAIL_OPTIONS}
										slotProps={{
											chip: {
												variant: 'soft',
											},
										}}
										sx={(theme) => {
											const minHeight = theme.spacing(16.5);
											return {
												minHeight,
												'& fieldset': {
													minHeight,
												},
											};
										}}
									/>
									<Typography
										variant="caption"
										sx={{ mt: 1, color: 'text.secondary', display: 'block' }}
									>
										{t('unregistered-emails-will-receive-invitation')}
									</Typography>
								</CardContent>
							</Card>

							{/* Permissions Card */}
							<Box>
								<HelperText
									errorMessage={form.formState.errors.permissions?.message}
									helperText={
										!form.formState.errors.permissions
											? t('at-least-one-permission-required')
											: undefined
									}
									sx={{
										mb: 1,
										mx: 0,
										...(form.formState.errors.permissions
											? {}
											: { color: 'text.secondary' }),
									}}
								/>
								<Card
									id="section-permissions"
									sx={(theme) => {
										return {
											'--error': theme.vars.customShadows.cardErrorOutline,
											'--normal': theme.vars.customShadows.card,
											boxShadow: 'var(--shadow-card)',
										};
									}}
									style={{
										['--shadow-card' as string]: form.formState.errors
											.permissions
											? 'var(--error)'
											: 'var(--normal)',
									}}
								>
									<CardHeader
										title={
											<Box
												sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 1 }}
											>
												<Typography variant="h6">{t('permissions')}</Typography>
												<Tooltip
													title={t('at-least-one-permission-required')}
													placement="top"
												>
													<IconButton
														size="small"
														sx={{ p: 0.5, color: 'text.secondary' }}
													>
														<Iconify icon="solar:info-circle-bold" width={20} />
													</IconButton>
												</Tooltip>
											</Box>
										}
									/>
									<CardContent>
										<QueryDisplay
											query={permissionsQuery}
											LoadingSlot={PermissionsSkeleton}
										>
											{({ data }) => {
												const transformedData = transformPermissionsData(
													data?.additionalData as unknown as Record<
														string,
														Record<
															string,
															{ key: string; name: string; description: string }
														>
													>,
												);

												return (
													<>
														{_.map(transformedData, (group) => (
															<Box
																key={group.moduleKey}
																id={`section-permission-${group.moduleKey}`}
																sx={{ scrollMarginTop: '100px' }}
															>
																<List
																	subheader={
																		<ListSubheader sx={{ px: 0 }}>
																			{group.module}
																		</ListSubheader>
																	}
																>
																	{_.map(group.permissions, (permission) => {
																		const isChecked =
																			permissions?.includes(permission.key) ??
																			false;
																		return (
																			<PermissionListItem
																				key={permission.key}
																				permission={permission}
																				checked={isChecked}
																				onToggle={() => {
																					handlePermissionToggle(
																						permission.key,
																					);
																				}}
																			/>
																		);
																	})}
																</List>
															</Box>
														))}
													</>
												);
											}}
										</QueryDisplay>
									</CardContent>
								</Card>
							</Box>
						</Stack>

						<FloatingCard
							placement="bottom-center"
							offset={20}
							sx={{
								borderRadius: 2,
								display: 'flex',
								gap: 2,
								maxWidth: 700,
								padding: 1,
								width: 'fit-content',
								zIndex: 1000,
							}}
							parentContainerRef={
								floatingCardContainerRef as RefObject<HTMLElement | null>
							}
						>
							<Button
								type="submit"
								variant="contained"
								disabled={isPending}
								loading={isPending}
							>
								{_.capitalize(t('create-profile'))}
							</Button>
						</FloatingCard>
					</Form>
				</Stack>
			</Grid>
		</Grid>
	);
};

const PermissionListItem = ({
	permission,
	checked,
	onToggle,
}: {
	permission: Permission;
	checked: boolean;
	onToggle: () => void;
}) => {
	return (
		<ListItem
			sx={{ py: 0, px: 0 }}
			secondaryAction={
				<Switch
					edge="end"
					checked={checked}
					onChange={onToggle}
					color="success"
					slotProps={{
						input: {
							id: `${permission.key}-switch`,
							'aria-label': `${permission.key} switch`,
						},
					}}
				/>
			}
		>
			<ListItemButton sx={{ px: 0, pl: 1 }} onClick={onToggle}>
				<ListItemAvatar>
					<Avatar>
						<Iconify icon="solar:key-bold" width={24} />
					</Avatar>
				</ListItemAvatar>
				<ListItemText
					primary={permission.name}
					secondary={permission.description}
				/>
			</ListItemButton>
		</ListItem>
	);
};

export default NewStaffProfileForm;

// Skeleton loader for permissions list
const PermissionsSkeleton = () => {
	const modules = [
		{ id: 'module-1', itemCount: 4 },
		{ id: 'module-2', itemCount: 5 },
		{ id: 'module-3', itemCount: 3 },
	];
	const primaryWidths = [180, 200, 160, 220, 170]; // Fixed widths for variety
	const secondaryWidths = [250, 280, 240, 300, 260]; // Fixed widths for variety

	return (
		<>
			{modules.map((module) => (
				<List key={module.id}>
					<ListSubheader sx={{ px: 0 }}>
						<Skeleton variant="text" width={120} height={24} sx={{ mb: 1 }} />
					</ListSubheader>
					{Array.from({ length: module.itemCount }).map((_, itemIndex) => {
						const primaryWidth =
							primaryWidths[itemIndex % primaryWidths.length];
						const secondaryWidth =
							secondaryWidths[itemIndex % secondaryWidths.length];

						return (
							<ListItem
								key={`${module.id}-item-${itemIndex}`}
								sx={{ py: 0, px: 0 }}
								secondaryAction={
									<Skeleton
										variant="rectangular"
										width={44}
										height={24}
										sx={{ borderRadius: 12 }}
									/>
								}
							>
								<ListItemButton sx={{ px: 0, pl: 1 }} disabled>
									<ListItemAvatar>
										<Skeleton variant="circular" width={40} height={40} />
									</ListItemAvatar>
									<ListItemText
										primary={
											<Skeleton
												variant="text"
												width={primaryWidth}
												height={20}
											/>
										}
										secondary={
											<Skeleton
												variant="text"
												width={secondaryWidth}
												height={16}
												sx={{ mt: 0.5 }}
											/>
										}
									/>
								</ListItemButton>
							</ListItem>
						);
					})}
				</List>
			))}
		</>
	);
};

```


Fixed both issues:

1. **Removed redundant typing**: `PermissionSlice` already includes `moduleKey: string`, so `& { moduleKey: string }` was redundant.

2. **Changed `Array<>` to bracket notation**: Replaced `Array<PermissionSlice>` with `PermissionSlice[]`, which is the idiomatic TypeScript syntax.

The return type is now `PermissionSlice[]` instead of `Array<PermissionSlice & { moduleKey: string }>`.
